independent_prior.role: exact full-grammar oracle, deliberately privileged structural prior; NEVER claim same prior as learner

objective: Measure on identical FRESH public causal action-effect transcripts how much previously qualified source-blind WSP135 direct latent factor learner and independent same-information symbolic equivalent miss relative to an exact fully specified 7062-function grammar oracle and fully fitted CART. Identify information-vs-representation gap without retroactive WSP135 cohort reuse.

source.prohibited: all other seeds incl 194800..194863,195800..195863,196800..196863, old WSP131..135 and all original-source scientific cohorts
source.opaque_ids: fresh per world and relabel; public typed x and all candidate actions available before selection
source.known_generator: random.Random(int.from_bytes(sha256('WSP136|KNOWN|'+seed),'big')) shuffle six input bits; gate1 and gate2 independently chosen from AND OR XOR XNOR; gate3 from same choices; output gate3(gate1,g2) XOR (bit4 AND bit5 if seed even else bit4)
source.unfamiliar_generator: random.Random(SHA256('WSP136|UNFAMILIAR|'+seed)) shuffle six inputs; gate1 and gate2 chosen from AND OR XOR XNOR; output majority(gate1,gate2,bit4) XOR bit5
source.first_use_scope: fresh public synthetic diagnostic; not original benchmark scientific first-use; deny all original-source opening

arms.shared_interventions: Use original pinned WSP135 source-blind N.schedule() fixed 32 distinct x for each world. Source custodian executes once per world and source receipts shared read-only across each arm. Zero additional calls for controls.
arms.native: Existing exact WSP135 numerical LatentInducer from parent at SHA 84833d7607253df297b1dfe5afec6ba31cb36815; no algorithm edit.
arms.symbolic: Existing original WSP135 independently implemented ExactSymbolicFactor from same parent; same input/effect, exact action and prediction parity required; not a class-informed oracle.
arms.oracle: Copy exact pinned PR1179 oracle.py blob into new WSP136/oracle.py. Full 7062-member combined known/majority truth-function menu supplied by design. Fed identical x,effect transcript without source seed/label; no adaptive extra actions.
arms.cart: Existing fully trained conventional WSP135 depth<=6 CART on identical 32 events; report training errors and withheld scores.

metrics.oracle_information_sufficient_if: oracle correct >=95% within each 384 withheld cohort AND no confidently wrong predictions. Otherwise information_sufficiency NOT SHOWN FOR THIS POLICY; do not confuse with intrinsic impossibility.
metrics.learner_gap_closed_if: source-blind WSP135 correct >=95% of oracle CORRECT within unfamiliar cohort AND <=1% confidently wrong, independent symbolic parity, all source constraints pass. This is developmental representation gap criterion only, NOT scientific improvement proof.
metrics.paired_score: On exact same 768 outcome labels and source actions report oracle-minus-native correct coverage, paired disagreement/abstention, oracle/source membership, CART scores, and negative controls. No cross-PR cohort comparison.
metrics.source_membership: source held truth must occur exactly in grammar oracle universe for all 24 worlds, checked SOURCE-ONLY after event ledger sealed; no hidden truth leakage into learning.
metrics.retention: snapshot+checksum cold replay, zero-action relabel 6 old laws, no interference
metrics.process_cost: all arms full wall/cpu/tracemalloc; source effects and oracle construction separately where possible; whole-process energy unqualified

limits: No native Yggdrasil admission or causal-science PASS
No original DTR first-use absent source-owner virgin custody
No training on WSP117..135 exposed held scores
No edits to WSP135 old algorithms/source or two similarly named PR1179/1180
No new external controller/scheduler/paid API/private runner
No claim grammar-informed oracle is equal structural prior
No duplicate simulation runs or retained source consumed twice
